summary: Before settling on {theme}, a member checks whether another coin might carry it that year.
realLife: Christopher Capozzola asked whether the Native American dollar and a youth sports quarter might both feature surfing in the same year.
gates: Two release calendars under discussion could feature the same subject.
inGame: needs: overlapping program subjects and dates.

turns.what: The other series moves surfing to a later year.
turns.writesBack: The programs now list separate release years.
The two briefs identify their different subjects.
